label_rules:
Real-data evaluation: detection, retrieval and catalog association kept separate.

Labels: a match is "catalog-relevant" when its interval overlaps the predicted
arrival window [P - pre, S + post] of a USGS-cataloged regional earthquake at the
same station; "same-source" additionally requires that event to lie within 50 km
epicentral and 30 km depth of the query's associated event. These are derived
reference labels with location and travel-time uncertainty, not ground truth.
Uncataloged earthquakes exist in this region, so a non-relevant match can still
be a real earthquake; precision here is a lower-bound style diagnostic.

representation.instrument_response: not removed; raw digitizer counts are stored and compared only within one station/channel

provenance.postgres: PostgreSQL 17.6 (Debian 17.6-2.pgdg12+1) on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 12.2.0-14+deb12u1) 12.2.0, 64-bit

ingestion.queue_backlog: replay ingestion is synchronous (no queue); live backlog is reported by the SeedLink source status and was not exercised in this evaluation
ingestion.reconnects: not applicable to replay; live mode was not run for this report

query_selection.rule: all associated; unassociated evenly spaced in time
all associated; unassociated evenly spaced in time
all associated; unassociated evenly spaced in time

notes: pooled-pg scores every reference segment window (stride 512); gallery modes score only the bounded gallery (detector-trigger windows plus a background grid).
Queries are held-out episode-first triggers; galleries contain reference data only.
catalog-relevant precision undercounts real earthquakes: the region has many uncataloged events.
